title: Anthropic Warns Prospective Investors of Trump Administration Retaliation Risk
summary:
The AI firm warned potential shareholders in its S-1 registration statement that its advocacy for AI safety could result in "disproportionate and selective targeting" from the Trump administration. Anthropic disclosed that while it faces risks of government retaliation over these positions, it does not plan to change its stances.

The warning was included in the company's regulatory filings as it prepares to go public.
